reinspection.proof: Web extraction rechecked proof pp1–4 including license and Table1 cases4a/5a/6a. Later web page-range requests timed out.

rights: CC BY-NC-ND4.0 article; Elsevier proof/publication relationship retained. Facts-only original notes and locators;no PDF,figures,interview corpus or clinical dataset distributed.
dunne: 1927 ranked scan metadata only/body uninspected. Later Faber/FadedPage witness includes1939 publication history and1934 third-edition additions;ChapterX/AppendixIII recording practice only. No serial-time or prophetic rules transferred.
limits: Retrospective selected clinical sample,expert consensus and incomplete historical reports;no diagnostic accuracy,memory authenticity or forecasting validation. Authors reserve deja-reve principally for first two categories;dreamy-state distinct.
